name: Tortilla de Yema
description: Tortilla de huevo cremosa con una yema extra.
hints: Añade la yema extra a los huevos antes de batir para conseguir mayor cremosidad.
Mezcla en el bol con la sal para hacer la mezcla de Huevo y Yema.
Cocina a fuego lento para mantener la textura cremosa.
cooklang:
Separate @extraEgg{1%pcs} in the bowl to obtain an extra yolk.
Beat the @eggs{6%pcs} in the bowl with @salt{1%tsp} and extra yolk to make Huevo batido con yema.
Heat the @oil{100%ml} in the pan.
Pour the Huevo batido con yema into the pan.
Stir slightly and cook for 5 minutes.
Flip the tortilla.
Cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve onto the plate as Tortilla de Yema.

steps.instruction: Separate one egg in the bowl to get an extra yolk.
Whisk main eggs vigorously in the mixing bowl!
Mix beaten eggs with the extra yolk and salt using the whisk!
Heat oil in the small pan on burner 1.
In the small pan cook egg and yolk mixture until soft and golden!
